title: Implement snap-to-grid and snap-to-objects in stage drag
description: snapToGrid and snapToObjects flags exist in the document model but StageArea.tsx does not use them during drag operations. snapToGrid: during drag/move, quantize object position to the nearest grid cell (gridX x gridY spacing from docProperties). snapToObjects: during drag, snap object edges/center to nearby objects' edges/centers (within a ~5px snap radius). The snap-to-guides already works — use it as a reference for the implementation pattern.
